required_gates: probe and public result save complete
fatal, dump, Windows exception, access violation, device lost, TDR, CUDA illegal address and upload attempt all zero
remaining PID, kit.exe path and process start time verified
lightweight diagnostic completed inside its timeout and memory limit
non-invasive lightweight stack matches the known NGX telemetry signature
outer runner termination completes and PID disappears

lightweight_evidence.debugger_attach: CDB non-invasive (-pv), bounded to 45 seconds and 512 MiB Private Bytes via the Phase 6EA guarded helper
lightweight_evidence.capture_lock: Phase 6EA atomic output lock; live owner rejects duplicates and stale ownership is start-time checked
lightweight_evidence.failure_contract: A debugger/helper failure is unknown and does not authorize terminating the target Kit process.
lightweight_evidence.stack_processing: stdout/stderr go directly to files; required tokens are searched without loading the whole stack log into PowerShell memory
records: Kit/Flow versions from the probe plus driver and GPU inventory
GPU inventory and DLSS/AA settings where the probe exposes them
PID, executable, process start time and Kit file version
last lifecycle marker and completion contract
final shutdown log lines and stack fingerprint

historical_baseline.scope: Phase 6DW 14 processes + Phase 6DY 8 processes + Phase 6DZ control + Phase 6EA direct control
historical_baseline.note: The Phase 6DZ residual predates lightweight signature capture and is not retroactively labeled known.

reinvestigation_triggers: new stack signature, module or fault offset
hang before result save or stage close
known residual rate above 5% with at least 20 policy-classified processes
fatal, Windows exception, Fabric access violation, TDR or device lost
target PID cannot be identified or terminated safely
behavior worsens after driver or Kit update
distribution_rule: Run a longer pre-distribution soak; this policy is evidence collection, not proof that shutdown is fully normal or harmless on every machine.
